data.name: Program_Usage
data.value:
Quasar: spectrum-centric search of the MS2 signal a peptide-centric search leaves unexplained.
Usage: Quasar -i <run.raw|run.mzML> [-o <out.quasar.mzML>] [--windows <first>[-<last>]] [--threads <n>] [--osprey-blib <osprey.blib>] [--features unassigned|all] Quasar --version Show the version. Quasar --help Show this help.
Writes one pseudo-spectrum per co-eluting cluster to mzML, for a search engine such as Sage, and the clusters with precursor candidates, one copy per candidate, to <out>.precursors.mzML. With --osprey-blib, the precursors Osprey found in this run at 1% are known templates and only the signal they leave unexplained is clustered (--features unassigned); --features all clusters all of it.
